points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, enabling autonomous multi-step decision making and reliable information retrieval.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for enterprise knowledge bases.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring responsible AI compliance.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and enabling efficient scaling of agentic workflows.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant prompts by 25%, demonstrating capability in optimizing autonomous agent ecosystems.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable AI microservices using Docker and Azure, ensuring robust pipelines for production GenAI applications.
